source_title: Users and households appliances: design suggestions for a better, sustainable interaction.
article_summary: The article examines how household appliance interfaces, manuals, feedback, and automation can influence users toward more sustainable appliance use. It argues that unclear eco-programs, poor communication, and user misconceptions often prevent energy- and water-saving behaviors, especially for washing machines, dishwashers, ovens, fridges, and similar appliances. The paper proposes clearer interfaces, personalized suggestions, proactive feedback, automation, and energy-consumption communication as design strategies that could support greener smart-home rules while respecting different user capabilities.
